variations.title: Another backup or restore is running

output: Backing up to a directory on this machine (/backups), not offsite: no bucket is configured...
Another backup or restore is running; try again when it has finished.
steps.note: Every backup and restore holds one PostgreSQL lease, so a second one at the same moment is refused and changes nothing. Exit code 1.

variations.title: The backup key is not 32 bytes

output: Backing up to a directory on this machine (/backups), not offsite: no bucket is configured...
ENDGAME_BACKUP_KEY is not 32 bytes written as hex or base64, so no backup runs.
steps.note: The key must be 64 hex characters or base64 of 32 bytes (openssl rand -hex 32). With this key /health is also unhealthy (OPS-18), so the ops container fails its health check and the compose line before it fails first.

steps.note: Once tomorrow's archive would pass 80% of the allowance the usage line starts with WARNING:. Past the allowance it says to keep fewer archives (ENDGAME_BACKUP_KEEP_DAILY / _WEEKLY) or accept the charge. Earlier lines are left out. Sizes are illustrative.
